themes.name: Daybreak
themes.author: StoryLark
themes.description: StoryLark's own face — warm paper instead of stark white, a dawn-teal accent, a gold "birdsong" read-along highlight, and a literary reading serif. Ships as the default theme in every StoryLark build.
themes.install: Copy brands/storylark to brands/<your-id> and retune the tokens in theme.css.

templates.name: Classic Library
templates.author: StoryLark
templates.description: The default presentation: a flat library of stories with Home, Library, word-synced Reader, Now Playing, and Settings screens. Read, Listen, or Read + Listen per story, offline downloads, and install-to-home-screen built in.
templates.install: The base build ships this template; set layout: "flat" in brand.json.
